part.name: Exploded 3D-printer hotend and extruder mounting assembly
part.description: Nine-solid exploded mechanical model comprising two main extruder or hotend bodies, a mounting cradle, a tubular heat-break or guide component, two clamp or heater blocks, and three threaded nozzle or fastener components. The solids are spatially separated in the STEP file and appear to represent distinct functional components rather than accidental disconnected geometry.
part.symmetry_note: Many individual components exhibit bilateral symmetry, paired bores, coaxial stepped holes, and regularly repeated thread or cooling-fin geometry. The complete STEP arrangement is an exploded presentation and is not globally symmetric.

semantic_orientation.description: The most likely installed orientation places the long nozzle, heat-break, and filament-path axes vertically. The upper faces of the blocks are therefore treated as top-facing and the nozzle-tip direction as downward. Horizontal front, back, left, and right assignments are less certain because the components are shown exploded.
